contributions.original_prompts:
New raw `raw/stripe-payouts-next-day-settlement-2026-11-07.md`. Prior raw `raw/stripe-payouts-next-day-2026.md`. Current summaries `wiki/sources/source-stripe-payouts-next-day.md`.

- Q1. For `https://docs.stripe.com/payouts/next-day-settlement`, what documented behavior, prerequisites, actors and state transitions does the complete new capture establish? How do these compare with the matched prior capture and each mapped summary?

- Q2. Which changes are substantive, presentational or navigation-only? Identify the exact dated qualifications, conflicts and reciprocal routes that the proposed disposition should preserve.

reviewed_answers.Q1: The November capture of https://docs.stripe.com/payouts/next-day-settlement lists 24 Dashboard-user countries, directs Connect platforms to their account team, and says new users do not immediately qualify (new raw lines 11-38 and 347-349). Eligible domestic card and non-debit funds become available in the Stripe balance next business day; automatic daily schedules send them to the bank next business day, while the manual, weekly and monthly examples end at balance availability and bank arrival can vary (new raw lines 9-13 and 40-330). The regional table lists direct debit and nonlocal-currency international card exclusions while preserving standard settlement for excluded funds (new raw lines 351-360). May and source-stripe-payouts-next-day.md give a US-only account, domestic non-ACH funds and a 0.6% monthly fee (old raw lines 8-12 and 34-52). November retains the prior-month fee basis and available-balance debit cadence but gives no rate (new raw lines 362-375).
reviewed_answers.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/payouts/next-day-settlement, substantive November changes are listed-country expansion and regional exclusions/thresholds, including Australia AUD 99 million, US USD 1 million, no payout limit listed for Eurozone or UK and no volume cap on Stripe balance (new raw lines 11-38 and 332-360; old raw lines 34-40). Expanded timing diagrams add detail on standard versus next-day and bank versus Stripe balance, while heading/style changes are presentational (new raw lines 40-330). Preserve May's US-only, eligible domestic non-ACH and quoted 0.6% as date-bound in source-stripe-payouts-next-day.md (old raw lines 8-12 and 34-64). November omits the percentage but retains monthly assessment and distinguishes next-day from on-demand Instant Payouts (new raw lines 362-375). Keep the reciprocal Stripe Payouts concept route and separate Instant Payouts guide, without inferring account eligibility or bank arrival from example calendars.
